final_candidates.decision_summary: Conservative Met-to-Leu swap in E domain III with strong concordant support: ~27% natural Leu frequency in MSA, ESM-1v score 1.0, and favorable ProteinMPNN delta logP (+1.80), indicating high tolerability without viability risk.
Strong PLM and structure compatibility; although mutant frequency in MSA is low, position 154 sits in the glycan loop known to modulate flavivirus fitness, supporting moderate confidence.
Charge-conserving Lys-to-Arg with moderate PLM and structural support, but zero natural mutant frequency at a conserved position lowers confidence in a fitness gain.

stop_reason.detail: Available evidence dimensions are exhausted for discriminating tolerability; remaining tools (toxin, static annotation, n/a phenotype) would not alter the Top-3 ranking.

history.rationale: Position 154 is the conserved E glycosylation site; removing the glycan can accelerate assembly/budding and has been linked to enhanced replication in mammalian cells for flaviviruses.
Residue 154 is in the glycosylation motif region (153-154-155); removing the N-linked glycan can enhance mammalian-cell replication of flaviviruses. Pending MSA/PLM confirmation.
Strong PLM and structure support; MSA mutant frequency low but glycan-loop position 154 (N-linked glycosylation motif) is known to modulate flavivirus fitness, so tolerated with moderate confidence.
Conservative DIII substitution likely tolerated; DIII variation is common among naturally fit ZIKV lineages.
Conservative substitution in domain III, likely tolerated and possibly improving fusion/fitness; needs evidence.
Consistently top-scoring across MSA (27% natural L frequency), ESM-1v (1.0), and ProteinMPNN (ΔlogP=+1.80); conservative Met→Leu swap in E-domain III unlikely to impair viability.
DIII surface lysine-to-arginine is highly conservative and may fine-tune electrostatics for receptor/attachment factor binding.
Conservative charge-preserving change in domain III surface; low-risk fitness candidate pending evidence.
Conservative Lys→Arg keeps positive charge; PLM and structure are moderately supportive, but zero natural frequency at a conserved site lowers confidence.
Position 473 lies in the stem/transmembrane-adjacent region; small hydrophobic swaps there are often tolerated and may improve assembly. Verify WT=V473.
No MSA support, weak PLM score (0.26), and structure evidence unavailable due to WT mismatch; stem/TM-adjacent swaps risk assembly defects.

rejection.reason: No MSA support, weak PLM score (0.26), and structure evidence unavailable due to WT mismatch; stem/TM-adjacent swaps risk assembly defects.
